commands.cmd: p=$(command -v mcporter) && echo "resolves: $p -> $(readlink -f "$p")" && mcporter --version && python3 -c "import json,glob,sys;c=sys.argv[1];print('stack',[x['version'] for x in json.load(open('manifests/stack.json'))['components'] if x['id']==c],'winner pins',sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers',[]) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id')==c}))" mcporter

S=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
mkdir -p "$S/ws" "$S/cfg" "$S/mchome"
cat > "$S/mcporter.json" <<JSON
{"mcpServers":{"headroom":{"command":"headroom","args":["mcp","serve","--proxy-url","http://127.0.0.1:1"],"env":{"HEADROOM_OFFLINE":"1","HF_HUB_OFFLINE":"1","TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE":"1","DO_NOT_TRACK":"1","HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR":"$S/ws","HEADROOM_CONFIG_DIR":"$S/cfg"}}},"imports":[]}
JSON
EP="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"
snap() { for f in "$HOME/.claude/settings.json" "$HOME/.claude/plugins/installed_plugins.json" "$HOME/.codex/config.toml" "$HOME/.serena/serena_config.yml"; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '%s ' "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"; else printf 'ABSENT '; fi; done; if [ -d "$HOME/.claude/hooks" ]; then find "$HOME/.claude/hooks" -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; 2>/dev/null | sort | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1; else printf 'HOOKS_ABSENT'; fi; }
before_files=$(snap)
bt=$(mktemp); pgrep -f 'mcporter|headroom' | sort > "$bt"
list_out=$(env -i HOME="$S/mchome" PATH="$EP" mcporter --config "$S/mcporter.json" list headroom --brief --no-oauth 2>&1); list_rc=$?
call_out=$(env -i HOME="$S/mchome" PATH="$EP" mcporter --config "$S/mcporter.json" call headroom.headroom_stats --output json --no-oauth --timeout 20000 2>&1); call_rc=$?
keys_ok=$(printf '%s' "$call_out" | python3 -c "
import json, sys
try:
    d = json.load(sys.stdin)
except Exception:
    print('INVALID_JSON'); sys.exit(0)
need = ('compressions', 'retrievals', 'total_tokens_saved')
print('True' if all(k in d and isinstance(d[k], int) for k in need) else 'False')
")
sleep 0.5
at=$(mktemp); pgrep -f 'mcporter|headroom' | sort > "$at"; new=$(comm -13 "$bt" "$at")
after_files=$(snap)
rm -rf "$S" "$bt" "$at"
files_same="no"; [ "$before_files" = "$after_files" ] && files_same="yes"
echo "MCPORTER_USE list_rc=$list_rc call_rc=$call_rc stats_keys_ok=$keys_ok new_pids=[$new] config_files_unchanged=$files_same"
echo "list (explicit scratch config, imports disabled, one headroom entry): $(printf '%s' "$list_out" | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-150)"
echo "headroom_stats returned compressions/retrievals/total_tokens_saved as ints: $keys_ok"
echo "fixed-list config snapshot (settings.json, installed_plugins.json, hooks/, codex/config.toml, serena_config.yml) unchanged: $files_same"
test "$list_rc" -eq 0 && test "$call_rc" -eq 0 && test "$keys_ok" = "True" && test -z "$new" && test "$files_same" = "yes" && echo "asserted: list and call both succeeded against an explicit headroom-only scratch config (no editor auto-import), headroom_stats' JSON carried the named integer counters, no surviving new PID, and this host's settings.json/installed_plugins.json/hooks/codex-config.toml/serena config were byte-for-byte unchanged"
